details:
This is AstroMiner, an educational video game created by four Honduran children using Lovable in just two days!

Designed for kids over 8, it combines science, astronomy, chemistry, and NASA data in an exciting adventure.

Players must complete 7 stages on Mars to unlock their journey to Jupiter. Along the way, they discover fun facts about planets and the periodic table.

The most exciting part? The Laboratory! Players examine 4 different minerals and test their knowledge through interactive questions.

Play solo or in multiplayer mode with up to 5 players, interacting and exploring with friends!

AstroMiner works on phones, tablets, and computers, in both English and Spanish.

AstroMiner: Explore, Play, Discover, and Learn! 🚀
